description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Fiscal Mangement (Responsibility) Act. No.03 of 2003. Mid Year Fiscal Position Report - 2024.
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the availability of the Mid-Year Fiscal Position Report 2024, which is issued under Section 10 of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 03 of 2003. The content primarily deals with a statutory requirement under existing financial legislation, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or specialized administrative matter.
